verified_bad_products.title: Car Wash Curtains
verified_bad_products.description:
Description

Car Wash Curtains are heavy-duty waterproof PVC curtain panels installed around car washing bays to contain water spray, foam, and sludge within the wash area. Hung on tracks or pipes, they act as flexible splash barriers while allowing easy vehicle movement and visibility for operators.

Features
  • Thick, waterproof PVC resistant to water, shampoo, and chemicals
  • Prevents splash spread to adjacent areas and equipment
  • Transparent or tinted options for visibility and light
  • Rust-proof eyelets with sliding/roll-up mounting options
  • Easy to clean, quick-dry, and low maintenance
  • Tear-resistant for long service life in wet environments
  • Custom sizes to suit single or multiple wash bays
  • Compatible with track-mounted or pipe-hung systems
Applications
  • Automobile service stations and detailing centers
  • Dedicated car and bike wash bays
  • Workshop washing and cleaning zones
  • Fleet maintenance depots and garages
  • Industrial equipment wash areas
